messages:
maria: Quick question for the group 11 when a tenant user clicks an audit export link, what do we actually capture in our telemetry right now?
kevin: Today we emit export_initiated with tenant_id, export_id and generator when available. For presigned downloads we only log presign_generated; the subsequent GETs go straight to the object store so we don't see them.
alex: Legal flagged this - they need 'who accessed which export and when' for some enterprise contracts. Presigned URLs break that because the download happens off-path. Options: make presigns require an authenticated session at generation time (so presign == attribution), or proxy the download through our servers and log each GET.
nora: Proxying everything is expensive (egress, infra ops). Could be opt-in per-tenant, or we proxy only for customers who require access-proof. We could also sample hosted customers.
maria: Important detail: the legal requirement applies to Dedicated and Private customers at high fidelity. Hosted customers are more flexible (sampling okay).
kevin: Proposed enum for export.metadata.attribution_mode = ["generate_only", "proxy_all", "proxy_when_enrolled"], default generate_only. Add telemetry event export_download_confirmed emitted when proxy endpoint logs an authenticated GET.
alex: API surface question: do we let callers pass an actor id into /presign? That's easy but dangerous (spoofable). Attribution should come from server-side authentication info, not client-supplied IDs.
nora: Agreed 1 no actor_id param. UI should show the actor that's about to be attributed before you click generate. And if the tenant is using proxy-mode, show a small banner explaining the proxy will log downloads.
maria: Console feature request: downloads table with columns: time, attributed_to (link), method (presign/proxy), file_hash, proof_link. Also add an option to bundle a signed proof artifact with the export.
kevin: Minimal API RFC sketch:
```
POST /v1/tenants/:tenant_id/exports
body: { format: "ndjson", include_proof: true, attribution_mode: "proxy_when_enrolled" }
response: { export_id, presign_url || download_proxy_url }
```
If attribution_mode != "generate_only" and tenant is enrolled, return download_proxy_url. Telemetry to emit: export_initiated, export_presign_generated, export_download_attempt, export_download_success, export_download_proxy_latency (with tags tenant, attribution_mode).
alex: For proxy flow: presign -> /v1/exports/:id/download?token=... endpoint should validate session, then either redirect or stream while logging. Capture range headers to record partial downloads.
nora: Billing / quota question: do proxy egress bytes count against tenant outbound quotas? Hosted probably yes; Dedicated maybe contract-dependent. Need to update billing UI and quota maths.
maria: Privacy note: telemetry can contain actor identifiers. We should store actor_uid in telemetry and provide a resolution service (with TTL) to map to email/username for audit viewers. Avoid storing raw emails in hot telemetry.
kevin: Alternative hybrid: generate a signed "proof_of_generation" JWT at export creation containing {export_id, generator_actor_id, ts, file_hash}. That gives proof the generator kicked off the export. But it doesn't prove a later download by another actor. For proof_of_access we need an on-path GET log.
alex: So proof_of_generation != proof_of_access. If contract requires proof_of_access we must log GETs. The signed JWT is useful for most cases and cheaper, but not sufficient for all enterprise requirements.
nora: Rollout plan suggestion: enable proxy_all by default for Dedicated/Private tenants. For Hosted, expose the flag and canary 5 tenants to start. Gate behind a feature flag 'audit-proxy'.
maria: Action items:
- kevin: write RFC with API shapes, telemetry fields and span names (export_initiated, export_presign_generated, export_download_attempt, export_download_success, export_download_proxy_latency).
- alex: design proxy implementation and the signed-proof-of-access artifact format.
- nora: console mockups for download attribution table and billing changes.
- maria: coordinate with legal and sales on contract language and comms.
Any other ideas or objections?
kevin: No objections, will open RFC + PR and attach sample telemetry payloads.
export-bot: Created ticket INFR-3123: "exports: add attribution_mode, download-proxy, telemetry + proofs" (<https://tracker.local/INFR-3123>) :white_check_mark:
maria: Also legal brought up retention: some customers require 7 years. We'll need retention tiering and option to stream export events to customer-owned buckets for long-term storage.
kevin: For retention we can optionally stream export_download_events to a customer S3 and include export event bundles in the exported artifact.
alex: Security note: if proxying we must stream with chunked transfer, keep memory bounded, and add per-tenant rate limiting. Also sign tokens tightly and rotate them.
nora: Quota edge-case: if download fails mid-stream, avoid double-billing. Use a quota token/checkout model where we decrement when stream completes or mark partial usage correctly.
maria: OK let's sync tomorrow 10am for mocks + API diffs.
kevin: I'll post RFC by EOD with sample telemetry fields.
